data.name: Afreeda
data.gender_notes: Afreeda is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'afra' which means 'to be pure'. The name Afreeda is derived from the Quranic Arabic word 'afrahd' which means 'free from sin'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to be pure and innocent in Islam. The name Afreeda carries the meaning “Pure, Free from Sin” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afreeda usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, free from sin and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing purity and righteousness.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afreeda total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
